core: botulinum neurotoxin intoxication of the motor nerve terminal
qualifier: serotypes A, B and E only
name: Botulinum neurotoxin serotype A, B and E intoxication
rationale: All three members are the toxicity routes of single botulinum serotypes acting on the nerve terminal, and naming the A/B/E serotypes separates it from the botC/D/G theme and from the cholinergic transmission and neurotransmitter release themes it would otherwise sit inside.

qualifier: tRNA charging and wobble modification plus amino-acid residue modification of translation factors
name: Translation elongation fidelity via tRNA charging and residue modification
rationale: Every member is either tRNA aminoacylation, an anticodon/wobble tRNA modification, or a covalent amino-acid residue modification of an elongation factor or protein, all serving elongation fidelity; this excludes the confusables' rRNA/mRNA/tRNA processing, protein methylation, readthrough and termination/decay content.

qualifier: cardiac mesoderm and secondary heart field specification into the heart tube
name: Cardiac mesoderm fate specification and early heart tube morphogenesis
rationale: The members all concern the earliest cardiac steps - mesodermal fate specification, secondary heart field specification and cardioblast proliferation, myoblast differentiation and heart tube/pericardium morphogenesis - whereas the confusables carry the later septum, valve, coronary and outflow tract morphogenesis.

core: neural progenitor division and neuronal fate acquisition
qualifier: catecholaminergic/sympathoadrenal output
name: Neuroblast asymmetric division and catecholaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: All members couple neuroblast/neural stem cell division and asymmetric division to neuronal differentiation, and the theme's own noradrenergic, sympathetic ganglion, adrenal and dopaminergic members make the fate catecholaminergic, unlike the confusables' glial, forebrain-patterning and midbrain-only content.

qualifier: connexin oligomerization, secretory trafficking and annular junction internalization
name: Connexon assembly, trafficking and gap junction turnover
rationale: Every member concerns making, delivering or removing the gap junction channel itself (connexon oligomerization, Golgi-to-membrane transport, annular junction formation, regulation of junction activity), while all confusables are about electrical coupling and conduction through junctions already in place.

qualifier: de novo route through IMP to AMP, GMP and XMP
name: De novo purine ribonucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: All members are de novo synthesis steps of purine ribonucleotides (IMP, AMP, GMP, XMP), which separates the theme from the pyrimidine biosynthesis confusable and from the salvage and nucleotide catabolism confusables.

core: nuclear pore complex and transport through it
qualifier: pore assembly/disassembly plus ribosomal subunit, inositol phosphate and viral Rev cargo
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic cargo transport
rationale: All members concern the nuclear pore itself - its assembly, mitotic disassembly and reformation, localization - or traffic through it (ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates, Rev import/export, nuclear periphery tethering), unlike the confusables' nuclear membrane and lamina remodeling, bulk mRNA export and SUMOylation.

qualifier: clathrin-dependent synaptic vesicle recycling together with postsynaptic receptor internalization
name: Synaptic vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
rationale: Every member is a trafficking or cytoskeletal step on one side of the synapse - clathrin coat dynamics and vesicle endocytosis/recycling presynaptically, AMPA receptor and neurotransmitter receptor internalization and localization postsynaptically - distinguishing it from generic Rab/ARF endosomal recycling, from plasticity and memory readouts, and from the calcium-triggered release cycle.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water handling with cation-chloride cotransport
name: Renal and cellular osmoregulation by vasopressin and salt cotransport
rationale: All members concern sensing or correcting osmotic and salt load, from cellular hyper/hypotonic and osmosensory responses to renal sodium, chloride, potassium and water transport; the vasopressin receptor, aquaporin and SLC12 cotransporter members distinguish it from the renin-angiotensin blood pressure confusables and from the magnesium/paracellular and P-type ATPase ones.

qualifier: clathrin coat assembly and disassembly
name: Clathrin coat dynamics in synaptic vesicle endocytosis
rationale: The six members are exactly clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and the clathrin-dependent endocytic retrieval arm of the synaptic vesicle cycle, not the presynaptic cytoskeleton and active zone, cargo loading into other granules, or postsynaptic receptor trafficking seen in the confusables.

qualifier: amino-acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate
name: Glycine and threonine catabolism with xenobiotic acid conjugation
rationale: The members pair mitochondrial glycine and threonine breakdown (and its regulation) with the glycine/glutamine conjugation reactions that dispose of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which sets it apart from the proline, alanine and glyoxylate metabolism and the generic obsolete amino-acid categories in the confusables.

qualifier: erythroid and megakaryocyte-platelet arm, including RUNX1 control and red cell maturation
name: Erythroid and megakaryocytic commitment from hematopoietic progenitors
rationale: All members concern stem and myeloid progenitor regulation resolving into red cell or platelet output - erythrocyte differentiation and enucleation, oxygen transport, megakaryocyte development, RUNX1 programmes, spleen and marrow context - while every confusable adds the granulocyte, monocyte or macrophage branch instead.

qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and leukotriene branches with their G protein-coupled receptors
name: Cyclooxygenase prostanoid and leukotriene synthesis with their receptors
rationale: Members cover arachidonate release, the COX/prostaglandin-thromboxane and leukotriene synthetic routes, their transport and catabolism, and the prostanoid, leukotriene and free fatty acid receptors that read them, unlike the cytochrome P450 epoxygenase/HETE, lipoxin and histamine confusables.

qualifier: downstream kinase cascades and transcriptional output rather than ligand binding or adaptor recruitment
name: Neurotrophin TRK receptor downstream kinase and transcriptional signaling
rationale: Each member is an effector arm of activated TRKA/TRKB signaling - PI3K/AKT, CDK5, RAC1, p38MAPK, ERK5, CREB phosphorylation and NGF-stimulated transcription, plus BDNF responses - distinguishing it from the confusables' ligand-specific receptor activation steps, FRS2/ARMS adaptor recruitment and p75NTR death signaling.

qualifier: chambers, septa, valves and cushions, outflow tract vessels and conduction system
name: Cardiac chamber, septum, valve and conduction system morphogenesis
rationale: The members span the structural build of the heart - ventricular and atrial myocardium, septation, valve and endocardial cushion formation with its EMT, outflow tract and great vessel morphogenesis, and conduction system development - whereas the confusables are endothelial/vasculogenic identity, electrical coupling, or postnatal cardiomyocyte proliferation and hypertrophy.

qualifier: PKR and OAS effectors with ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing and restraint of type I interferon signaling
name: Interferon-induced dsRNA effectors PKR, OAS and ADAR editing
rationale: All members sit downstream of type I interferon on the dsRNA-handling branch - PKR and OAS effector responses, ADAR editosome formation and A-to-I editing, interferon-alpha and IL-27 responses, and negative regulation of interferon and kinase signaling - not the upstream sensing and IRF/TBK1 induction or endosomal TLR routes of the confusables.

qualifier: chain-length-specific routes with acyl-CoA intermediate metabolism
name: Chain-length-specific fatty acid beta-oxidation and acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members are beta-oxidation steps resolved by substrate chain length (medium, long, very long chain, pristanoyl-CoA, acyl-CoA oxidase route) together with the acyl-CoA intermediates they generate, rather than the carnitine shuttle, alpha-oxidation or peroxisomal import and biogenesis of the confusables.

qualifier: lipoprotein particle assembly, remodeling and clearance with bile acid synthesis and transport
name: Lipoprotein metabolism, bile acid synthesis and sterol homeostasis
rationale: Every member concerns sterol and phospholipid movement in lipoprotein particles (chylomicron, VLDL, LDL, HDL assembly, remodeling, clearance and receptor uptake) or the bile acid route that disposes of cholesterol, plus the SREBP/LXR and ABC transporter control over it - unlike the triglyceride storage and lipid droplet confusable and the xenobiotic/bilirubin transport ones.

core: ESCRT-III-mediated membrane sealing at mitotic exit
qualifier: nuclear envelope resealing and midbody abscission, with ESCRT complex disassembly
name: ESCRT-III membrane sealing at nuclear envelope reformation and abscission
rationale: The five members are the mitotic-exit sealing events carried out by ESCRT-III and its disassembly - nuclear membrane reassembly and organization, envelope sealing, midbody abscission - not the multivesicular body, exosome and viral budding uses of ESCRT, nor the lamina depolymerization and envelope disassembly steps of the other confusable.

qualifier: dense core vesicle release and G protein-coupled neuropeptide and opioid receptor activation
name: Neuropeptide release and G protein-coupled receptor signaling at synapses
rationale: All members are the mechanism of peptidergic transmission - presynaptic dense core vesicle exocytosis, neuropeptide synaptic signaling, orexin/NPFF/QRFP and opioid receptor engagement, G-protein activation and the resulting modulation of impulse transmission and wakefulness - whereas the confusables are behavioural readouts (stress, drug reward, mating) or sleep-stage processes.

core: microglial and astrocytic activation injuring neurons
qualifier: amyloid-beta and excitotoxic context with hippocampal neuron loss and synaptic depression
name: Microglial activation in amyloid and excitotoxic hippocampal injury
rationale: Members combine microglial proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity and astrocyte activation control with the insults and damage they accompany - amyloid-beta formation and response, kainate exposure, hippocampal neuron apoptosis, impaired long-term potentiation - unlike the confusables' phagocytic clearance machinery, microglial differentiation and amyloid/tangle handling.

core: amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance
qualifier: balance of positive and negative regulation of both, including transcytotic and catabolic clearance
name: Amyloid fibril assembly and amyloid-beta clearance balance
rationale: All members concern the aggregate itself - fibre formation and its positive and negative regulation - and the routes that remove amyloid-beta, which distinguishes it from confusables centred on glial responses to amyloid or on amyloid precursor protein synthesis, processing and tangle assembly.

core: mitochondrial fission and membrane potential control
qualifier: pro-fission, retention of mitochondrial proteins, and type 2 mitophagy
name: Mitochondrial fission, membrane potential and protein localization control
rationale: Members all set mitochondrial shape and state - promoting fission while suppressing fusion, raising or lowering membrane potential, retaining and importing mitochondrial proteins, and apoptotic fragmentation with type 2 mitophagy - unlike the confusables' PINK1-PRKN and receptor mitophagy, the import and processing machinery, and the cytochrome c release apoptotic arm.

qualifier: germinal centre reaction with naive, memory and plasma cell states and their surface signatures
name: Mature B cell germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are the antigen-experienced B cell compartment - germinal centre formation and B cell differentiation, follicular helper support and ICOS co-stimulation, plasma and memory cell differentiation, immunoglobulin output, and the naive/memory/plasma surface signatures - rather than early B cell development, BCR signaling or B cell homeostasis found in the confusables.

qualifier: SREBP and LXR sterol sensing with lipoprotein receptor endocytosis and degradation
name: Cholesterol sensing and lipoprotein receptor endocytic turnover
rationale: Every member is either transcriptional sterol sensing (SREBP activation, NR1H2/NR1H3 limits on uptake, sterol homeostasis, cholesterol efflux, storage and reverse transport) or the receptor-side endocytosis, recycling and lysosomal degradation that sets cholesterol uptake, distinguishing it from confusables built on lipoprotein particle remodeling, phospholipid efflux and intestinal and bile handling.
